title: DG Land Claims
description: The next generation of land protection.
body:
# DG Claims

**Place a block. Claim the land. That's it.**

DG Claims turns land protection into a single intuitive action: buy a region block from the shop, place it where you want your claim, right-click to manage everything from a clean GUI. No complex commands, no learning curve.


[**💬 Join the Discord →**](https://discord.gg/ZZhVKUtSNS)

---

## ✨ Features

### 🧱 Block-based claims
- Buy a region block from the in-game shop (Vault economy)
- Place it - your claim is automatically created around it (16×16 default, expandable up to 100×100)
- Right-click the block to open a full management GUI
- Pick it up anytime - your settings, members, and skin travel with you

### 👥 Roles & permissions
- **Owner** → **Co-Owner** → **Trusted** → **Member** → **Visitor**
- Per-role permission flags: build, break, interact, container access, PvP, and more
- Individual member overrides for fine-grained control
- Transfer ownership to anyone via the GUI

### 🚩 Region flags (all actually enforced)
- PvP toggle (applies to **everyone**, including the owner)
- Mob spawning filter (All / Hostile only / Passive only / None)
- Fire spread, lava/water flow (in & out), piston push-out
- Mob griefing (endermen, ravagers, withers)
- Leaf decay, hunger loss, keep inventory on death
- Item frame rotation, explosions, weather bypass

### 🛒 Marketplace
- List your claim for sale to other players
- Built-in **Inspection Mode**: buyers teleport in with 60s invulnerability + glow effect (no trap-attack exploits)
- Cooldowns, expiry, transparent transactions

### ⚔️ Combat protection
- Configurable combat tag (default 15s)
- Tagged players can't enter regions they aren't members of
- Anti combat-log: dying on rejoin
- Blocks `/spawn`, `/home`, `/tpa` while in combat (configurable)
- Bypass permission for staff

### 🎨 Visual customization
- 6 launch skins (Campfire default + more)
- Border styles: off, gold particles, custom-color particles (12 colors)
- Hologram, ambient particles, glow effects - all toggleable per region

### 🌍 Languages
Bundled translations: **English**, **Romanian**, **Polish**. Per-player language preference persisted across restarts. Add your own translation via a simple YAML file.

### 🔧 Storage & integrations
- **SQLite** (default, zero config) or **MySQL** (for networks)
- HikariCP connection pool
- **Vault** required (economy)
- **PlaceholderAPI** soft-dependency (region count, region name, owner, etc.)
- **bStats** anonymous metrics

---

## ⚡ Requirements

- **Paper / Purpur 1.21.x** or newer
- **Java 21+**
- **Vault** + an economy plugin (EssentialsX, CMI, etc.)

---

## 📋 Commands

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `/dgc` | Open the main menu |
| `/dgc shop` | Browse region blocks |
| `/dgc list` | List your regions |
| `/dgc lang <code>` | Change your language |
| `/dgcadmin` | Admin tools: reload, cleanup, delete, list, info, teleport |

Aliases: `/dgclaims`, `/claims`, `/claim`, `/dgca`.


# 🔒 Per-Flag Permissions

Every region flag is gated by a Bukkit permission node, letting you monetize features or restrict them to staff. Players without a flag's permission see a red-dye "Locked" placeholder instead of the flag icon - perfect for donor ranks.

## Available permissions

| Permission | Controls |
|---|---|
| `dgclaims.flag.*` | **Wildcard** - grants access to ALL flags |
| `dgclaims.flag.pvp` | PvP toggle inside the claim |
| `dgclaims.flag.mob-spawning` | Natural mob spawn filter (All / Hostile / Passive / None) |
| `dgclaims.flag.mob-griefing` | Block enderman, ravager, wither block changes |
| `dgclaims.flag.explosions` | TNT / creeper / end-crystal damage |
| `dgclaims.flag.fire-spread` | Fire propagation |
| `dgclaims.flag.lava-flow-in` | Lava entering the claim |
| `dgclaims.flag.lava-flow-out` | Lava leaving the claim |
| `dgclaims.flag.water-flow-in` | Water entering the claim |
| `dgclaims.flag.water-flow-out` | Water leaving the claim |
| `dgclaims.flag.piston-push-out` | Pistons pushing blocks out |
| `dgclaims.flag.leaf-decay` | Natural leaf decay |
| `dgclaims.flag.hunger-loss` | Hunger drop inside claim |
| `dgclaims.flag.keep-inventory-on-death` | Keep items on death |
| `dgclaims.flag.weather-bypass` | Bypass weather effects |
| `dgclaims.flag.item-frame-rotate` | Visitors rotating item frames |
| `dgclaims.flag.hologram` | Floating text above region block |
| `dgclaims.flag.ambient-particles` | Particles around the block |
| `dgclaims.flag.border-flash` | Border flash on enter/exit |
| `dgclaims.flag.block-glowing` | Glowing outline on block |
| `dgclaims.flag.border-style` | Visual border style picker |
| `dgclaims.flag.border-color` | Custom border color picker |
| `dgclaims.flag.welcome-message` | Custom welcome title |
| `dgclaims.flag.farewell-message` | Custom farewell title |

> **Default:** `op` - only operators see all flags. Regular players start with zero flags visible and must be granted access via your permission plugin (LuckPerms, GroupManager, etc.).

---

## 🔐 Why DG Claims over [other plugin]?

- **One block = one claim.** No `/claim` corner-selection nonsense.
- **Real flag enforcement.** Every flag in the GUI actually does what it says (most claim plugins ship 60% decorative flags).
- **Premium GUI.** Adventure components, MiniMessage colors, gradients - feels native to modern Minecraft.
- **Built for selling claims.** Marketplace + inspection mode are core features, not afterthoughts.
- **Translations as a first-class citizen.** Not a half-translated mod with hardcoded English strings.

---

## 🐛 Issues & support

Report bugs on the [issue tracker](#) or join our Discord. Pull requests for translations welcome - drop a new `lang/xx.yml` file.
